kit.about: Comfyture is an open-source creation desk for cinematic shots with sound: one photo in, a shot out; one sentence in, a short film out. The name is a pun on confiture, the French for jam and preserves: a jar keeps a shot until you are ready to open it.

voice.summary: Warm, plain and concrete. We say what a thing does, in short sentences, with at most one small jam pun.
dos: Lead with what you can make: a shot, a film, a trend.
Name the room: Story, Stage, Shot, Cut, Library.
One small jam or kitchen pun, never two.
Say open source and your own GPU or Comfy Cloud, plainly.
donts: No hype words: revolutionary, game-changing, unleash.
No exclamation marks, no emoji in headlines.
Never promise studio results: show a real take.
Never name or compare other products.

lines.say: One photo in, a shot with sound out.
lines.not: Unleash the power of AI video!

lines.say: Direct a shot. Or a whole film.

rules.text: Keep the lid on: use the supplied logo files; never redraw, retrace or recolour the logo.
Yellow on ink or plum. Ink on yellow or warm white.
Never yellow on a light ground (1.1 : 1), never plum on ink for text or the mark.
Clear space on every side equals the height of the lid. Wordmark at least 96 px wide, mark 24 px tall.
No shadows, glows or outlines on the logo. No stretching, rotating or busy pictures behind it.
Manrope 800 for headlines, Manrope 500 for reading, IBM Plex Mono for labels, numbers and ids.
Mostly ink and warm white; plum as a second ground; yellow in small, deliberate amounts (about a tenth).
Keep type inside the story safe zone: clear of the top 13% and the bottom 18%.
Show real output: a take, a trend, a screen of the app. Generated pictures never carry the logo or the headline.

brief.pitch: A warm, playful home for making films. A familiar kitchen spirit, with the tools to turn an idea into a shot.
brief.goal: Introduce Comfyture, the open-source creation desk for cinematic shots with sound, to makers: a launch week of posts, and a set the following weeks can reuse.
brief.audience: Indie filmmakers, motion designers and trend-minded creators who like to own their tools; people who already run ComfyUI or want to.
brief.message: Direct a shot, or a whole film, from one photo or one sentence. Open source, on your own GPU or in Comfy Cloud, with a real desk: Story, Stage, Shot, Cut, Library.
brief.tone: Warm, plain, concrete, a little playful. One jam pun at most. Show real takes, never promise studio results.
brief.deliverables: A brand board. Social layouts in 4:5, 1:1 and 9:16: launch, showcase, the assistant, the five rooms. A product hero. An eight second logo and product intro. Saved variations to test.
brief.constraints: Open source (MIT). Real screens and real takes only. Logos only from the supplied files; generated pictures never carry the logo or a headline. Type clear of the story's top 13% and bottom 18%. Never name or compare other products.
brief.channels: Instagram feed and stories, TikTok, X.

history.title: Concept 01 · Preserve seal
history.note: A pun to start from: confiture, comfyture. A jam label with the C as a fruit: too literal, but the jar stayed.

history.title: Concept 02 · Jar monogram
history.note: A C that is a jar. A strong shape, but heavy and cold next to the product.

history.title: Concept 03 · Ribbon wordmark
history.note: The flowing script in a label oval. The lettering that stayed.

history.title: Yellow, ink, plum, warm white
history.note: A world of jam and kitchen light: yellow as the signal, ink and plum as grounds, warm white for text.

history.title: Concept 07 · Lid on C: approved
history.note: The script with a lid fitted to the first letter: Comfyture comes to life in one stroke. “Second variation is nice, we'll use it.”

history.title: Brand files built from the approved lettering
history.note: Wordmark, mark and app icon as SVG in four colourways, plus PNGs, favicon and manifest: scripts/brand-build.py traced them from the board, so the lid is never lost.

history.title: The jar, as a prop
history.note: The wordmark on a yellow label, the mark on a plum lid. The pun in one picture: confiture, comfyture.

history.title: Brioche joins the cast
history.note: A baby lop-eared bunny with cream and apricot fur: the assistant in every room.

history.title: The brief for launch week
history.note: Introduce Comfyture, the open-source creation desk for cinematic shots with sound, to makers: a launch week of posts, and a set the following weeks can reuse.

history.title: The kit, filled from the identity
history.note: Eleven logo files on the grounds they are for, four colours with what each is for, Manrope and IBM Plex Mono, a voice and nine rules. Designs read the kit and the brand guard checks them against it.

history.title: Pictures made: Brioche, the jar of shots, the plum macro
history.note: GPT Image 2.5 Flare through Comfy Router, 18.7 credits for three. The jar's label and lid were left blank so the real wordmark goes on as a layer; the subjects were cut out with the app's own tool.

history.title: Two image partners tried on the same Brioche
history.note: FLUX 3 (14.48 credits) drew a richer fur and a tighter frame; GPT Flare (7.95) stayed closer to her sheet. Roles: Flare for characters and products from references, FLUX 3 for photographic scenes.

history.title: Launch · v1, first layout
history.note: Plum ground, the headline, Brioche peeking over the app's home screen. The badge hugged its words and the story layout sat too high.

history.title: Launch · v2, per-format layouts
history.note: A wider badge, the story layout moved down inside the safe zone, the square given its own place for Brioche. Approved.

history.title: Showcase · v1
history.note: Three Mixer trends as phone-shaped tiles, staggered. In the square the captions touched the tiles and the type was small.

history.title: Brioche explainer · v1
history.note: The assistant's speech bubble quoting a real Cut instruction, the four things she does as chips, her bar from the app below. The Render chip ran under Brioche and the bar was cropped from the wrong part of the screen.

history.title: Five rooms · v1
history.note: Yellow ground, ink type: the flip side of the identity. Numbers in mono, room names in Manrope 800. In the story the rows stopped halfway down its zone.

history.title: Product hero · v1
history.note: The jar of shots with the real wordmark laid on its blank label, a ring behind it for the lid. The line under the jar ran into its lid and the ring crossed the headline.

history.title: Brand board · v1
history.note: Logo, palette, type, mascot and jar on one page. The ink swatch vanished into the ground and Warm white broke onto its hex.

history.title: Five variations of the launch layout
history.note: Copy (the sentence first), colour (yellow ground), composition (a poster over the plum macro), intent (run it yourself) and format (the story first). Compared side by side.

history.title: Logo and product intro, 8 s
history.note: The wordmark wipes in with its lid lifted; the lid lands with a ripple and a soft pop; the wordmark settles into the launch layout; Brioche pops in; a yellow end card that holds, with the address, for the last second and a half.
